external_reference.after_change_vs_go2_rough: two terms differ: feet_air_time (0.2 vs 0.01, inherited from G-A033) and dof_acc_l2 (-1.25e-07 vs -2.5e-07, this run)
external_reference.departure_reason: Isaac Lab formula (reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:163 joint_acc): sum of squared joint accelerations. In our own logs this term is the price of moving: TERM_VALUES.csv raw joint acceleration is 912000 on G-A033 and 672000-848000 on every walking run, against 224000-532000 on every stopped run (the top is A015, go2_g_a015_pilot_feet_air_time_035). It is the largest single penalty G-A033 pays (-0.228). Isaac Lab sets the value for a policy trained 1500 iterations on its own curriculum; it is a comparison anchor, not a proven optimum (MASTER 1-b).
external_reference.literature: R-Sci-4 (Hwangbo 2019): a penalty the objective motion must pay is a stall risk. Here the walk margin (GO2_REWARD_MECHANISM_FORECAST.md section 7) rises to +0.2060, the largest of any probe, and stays inside the walking zone.
external_reference.r6: reward weight only; curriculum, terrain, DR and commands untouched. The weight is applied through the same env override path as the six listed names.

value_derivation.source: reports/GO2_REWARD_MECHANISM_FORECAST.md sections 1, 7 and 8-5; evidence reports/evidence/go2_reward_mechanism_20260917/ (PROBES.csv, TERM_VALUES.csv); reports/GO2_TUNING_BASE_DATA.md sections 0-1 and 1; reports/runs/TERRAIN_AT_PIN.csv
value_derivation.role: Penalize joint accelerations on the articulation using L2 squared kernel (Isaac Lab v2.3.1, isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:163): the cost of changing joint speed, that is, of lifting a foot fast.
value_derivation.walk_margin: G-A033 walk margin +0.1359 -> +0.2060 at -1.25e-07 (WALK), the largest rise of any probe in PROBES.csv; the walking zone ends at weight -4.64717e-07, so halving moves away from the edge, not toward it. Doubling instead (-5e-07) gives -0.0043, the stop zone: the term controls walking strongly in both directions.
value_derivation.situations: PROBE_SITUATIONS.csv leaves climb, sway and push empty for this term: the evaluation records carry no joint columns (forecast section 5-1). The situation direction is taken from the role and from the TERM_VALUES.csv raw values, not from a situation margin.
value_derivation.rule: half, not a smaller step: the probe grid in PROBES.csv holds half and double, half is the only probed value that stays in the walking zone, and no run has ever moved this term (range_status NEVER_CHANGED), so there is no observed range a fraction could sit inside. Half keeps the same order of magnitude as Isaac Lab.
value_derivation.not_claimed: No score gain is estimated. The margins are reward arithmetic on measured behaviour; they say the reward charges the walking and climbing gait less, not how many robots will climb a step.

why: Goal: every axis high while stairs rise. G-A033 loses most on G5 (stairs, 10.46) and G3 (rough side-step, 9.77).
Role first (Isaac Lab formula, reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:163): dof_acc_l2 charges squared joint acceleration -- the cost of lifting a foot fast.
Measured in our own logs: walking runs pay 672000-912000 raw, stopped runs 224000-532000. It is the price of moving.
It is the largest single penalty the frozen baseline pays (-0.228) and the one weight never moved in 18 trainings.
Walk margin: halving gives +0.2060, the largest rise of any probe, and the walking zone ends far away at -4.64717e-07.
Unknown named in advance: the evaluation records carry no joint columns, so sway and push directions are not predicted.

Levers not moved: of the six deployed names only feet_air_time is closed by measured rejections in both directions. The 2026-09-18 analyst readout (reports/GO2_TUNING_POLICY_READOUT_20260918.md section 2) refuted the earlier claim that all six are closed; the other five still carry unexplored directions, each of them OUT_OF_RANGE because no walking-baseline trial exists.
Risks pre-registered under fact_rules_v1: climbed-robot floors, per-scenario loss limits, flat guards, stationary guard.

notes.comparison_validity: Same seed 42, 4096 envs, 1000 iterations, evaluator and registry SHA as the stored G-A033 arm, evaluated at the same checkpoint iteration. The only difference is dof_acc_l2.
notes.not_claimed: No score gain is promised. One training seed cannot separate the lever from seed luck.
notes.deployed_list: dof_acc_l2 is not one of the six names in the deployed quadruped_rewards.py list; the file itself says lines may be added, and go2_task/env_cfg.py applies any name that is a RewTerm of the env. The candidate file therefore carries seven entries and the server log line '[OK] dof_acc_l2.weight = -1.25e-07' is the proof it was applied. Countervailing row found by the analyst on 2026-09-18 and not previously recorded: go2_task/_finalize.py:586 excludes extras (terms absent from REWARD_WEIGHTS) from its judgement because it has no baseline for them, so the deployed report generator does not list dof_acc_l2 as a participant change. Reading this term as inside R-6 is therefore our own call, not the deployment's: open decision U1-R6-ENV-REWARD-20260918 in reports/GO2_OPEN_DECISIONS.md.
notes.curriculum_lag: Both arms are read at iter 900. reports/runs/TERRAIN_AT_PIN.csv shows that a candidate whose curriculum lags is judged harshly there (G-A038 1.9499 against G-A033 4.4937 at the same pin), so the readout records the candidate's terrain level at 700/800/900/999 beside the baseline's.

dof_acc_l2.role: Penalize joint accelerations on the articulation using L2 squared kernel. [isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:163]
dof_acc_l2.out_of_range_reason: All 18 trainings ran -2.5e-07; there is no observed range for this term. The probe grid tests half and double, and only half stays in the walking zone.

walk_margin.reason: The evaluation records carry no joint columns, so no situation margin exists for this term; the stairs groups are target groups, so a climbing regression stops the run at stage 1.

inference.rule: fact-based inference chain (2026-09-17 user instruction; MASTER section 5, AGENTS 4-9); a point-gain estimate is not required
inference.role: Isaac Lab v2.3.1 dof_acc_l2 (isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:163) sums squared joint accelerations. It is charged every step and is paid hardest by whatever moves its joints fastest, which on stairs is the swing leg lifting onto the tread.

rows.reads: the frozen baseline's raw joint acceleration, the largest of the 17 measured runs
a stopped run pays about a quarter of it: this penalty is the price of moving, not a constant
halving raises the G-A033 walk margin from 0.1359 to 0.2060, the largest rise of any probe, and stays in the walking zone
no training run has ever moved this term; both probe directions are untested ground
base data names it the largest penalty of the frozen baseline and records that it was never tuned

rows.key: 관절 가속도² 합 벌점 — 관절 움직임을 부드럽게 한다
rows.reads: the role table assigns this term to the fast-foot motion of G5 (stairs) and G6 (push recovery)
the baseline's curriculum level at the pinned evaluation iteration, recorded next to the candidate's in the readout

inference.singularity: Every walking run pays 672000-912000 raw joint acceleration and every stopped run 224000-532000 (A015 is the top, TERM_VALUES.csv), yet the weight never moved in 18 trainings: the largest cost of the gait we want is the one dial nobody turned. The caution is A018, the only run that relaxed a penalty and still stopped (action_rate -0.01 -> -0.008); RUN_MARGIN.csv puts A018 at +0.0155, inside the boundary band where the margin model makes no claim, while G-A033 sits at +0.1359, about nine times the top of that band.

walk.basis: walk margin +0.1359 -> +0.2060 (PROBES.csv), the largest probe rise, far outside the boundary band

climb.basis: role only: the swing leg's acceleration onto a tread is what this term charges, and the runs that climb pay the most of it (TERM_VALUES.csv). No situation margin exists (PROBE_SITUATIONS.csv climb column empty), so the size is unknown

sway.basis: no joint columns in the evaluation records (forecast section 5-1)

push.basis: unknown, and deliberately not raised to 'up': the role table of reports/GO2_TUNING_BASE_DATA.md assigns this term to the fast-foot motion of G5 (stairs) and G6 (push recovery) alike, so the same role argument used for climb would apply here. It is not used, because the evaluation records carry no joint columns (forecast section 5-1) and one role sentence is not a second situation claim.

inference.falsified_if: the 10cm climb count falls below the pre-registered floor (climb_guard stairs_10_climb_ge1, baseline sum 90, max drop 6.671): a cheaper joint acceleration did not make the step-up easier, and the reading 'the acceleration penalty is what the stalling robot avoids' is refuted. Read from the climbed-robot counter, not from the mean terrain level, which is capped by the curriculum's random resend (reports/evidence/go2_curriculum_source_20260918/isaaclab_terrains_terrain_importer.py:314-321).
inference.seed_limit: Every training run used seed 42 and no seed replicate exists, so a result supports or refutes the chain; it does not fix a lever effect (reports/GO2_SEED_SENSITIVITY.md section 5).
inference.status_reason: Downgraded from RECOMMENDED on 2026-09-18 after the analyst readout and the audit. The contradicting block was empty while contradicting rows existed, which is preserved case M04: the author judged his own chain free of counter-rows. Three rows are now recorded, and our rule is that a chain with any contradicting row is not RECOMMENDED. The chain itself (term role, raw TERM_VALUES range, walk margin +0.2060) is untouched and independent of the refuted premise, so this is a hold and not a withdrawal; it sits behind the unexplored directions that are still open inside the deployed list.
